sentences.ko: 그리고 이제부터 내 결정은 다 네가 해 줘.
sentences.text: And from now on, you make all of my decisions for me.

alts.text: Just decide everything for me from now on.
Please make every decision for me from this point forward.

sentences.note: **from now on** 은 "지금부터 쭉"이라는 뜻으로, 앞으로의 규칙을 정할 때 문장 앞이나 뒤에 붙인다. 남에게 결정을 맡길 때는 **make all of my decisions for me** 처럼 for me 를 꼭 붙인다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 나 딱히 할 것도 없을 때 회사 그만두라고 한 사람이 너 아니었어?
sentences.text: Weren't you the guy that told me to quit my job when I had absolutely nothing else to do?

alts.text: Wait, you're the one who told me to quit my job when I had nothing else going on.
If I recall correctly, you were the person who advised me to quit my job when I had nothing else to do.

sentences.note: 상대가 예전에 한 말을 되짚으며 따질 때 **Weren't you the guy that** 처럼 부정 의문으로 연다 — "그거 너 아니었어?". **absolutely nothing** 은 nothing 을 한 번 더 세게 만드는 말이다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.text: So, I am just going to leave it entirely up to the gods of fate.

alts.text: I have decided to leave the matter entirely to fate.

sentences.note: 고르기를 포기하고 넘길 때 **leave it entirely up to** 뒤에 맡길 대상을 붙인다. 사람에게도 그대로 쓴다(leave it up to you). 짧게는 **let fate decide** 라고 한다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 나는 하루 종일 목욕가운 입고 땅콩 과자나 먹고 싶었어.
sentences.text: I wanted to wear my bathrobe and eat peanut clusters all day.

alts.text: All I wanted was to stay in my bathrobe and munch on peanut clusters all day.
My plan for the day was to remain in my bathrobe and eat peanut clusters.

sentences.note: 아무 데도 안 나가고 뭉개는 하루를 영어는 옷차림으로 말한다 — **wear my bathrobe**. 시간 범위인 **all day** 는 문장 맨 뒤에 붙이는 자리가 가장 자연스럽다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 그러다 도로 턱에 머리를 부딪혔고, 호루라기에 입술이 찢어졌어.
sentences.text: AND I HIT MY HEAD ON THE CURB and I cut my lip ON MY WHISTLE.

alts.text: Then I banged my head on the curb and split my lip on my whistle.
My head hit the curb, and my whistle cut my lip.

sentences.note: 다친 이야기를 할 때 영어는 **cut my lip** 처럼 내가 한 것으로 말한다 — "입술이 찢어졌다"를 수동으로 옮기지 않는다. 더 편하게는 **split my lip** 이라고 한다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 1 | Friends
